parameters.content:
## Send a text source to OmniGrowth
Env: OMNIGROWTH_API_URL, OMNIGROWTH_ENDPOINT_KEY, OMNIGROWTH_INBOUND_SECRET, OMNIGROWTH_BRAND_ID, NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto.
The endpoint can only ingest sources / start planning for its brands.

assignments.name: content
assignments.value: Replace this with the text to send (an article, notes, a transcript).
